pages.mainText:
FAQs
Home
FAQs
Find Answers for Questions You Have.
Everything you need to know before you travel with us. Our friendly team is always here to help.
Give us a chance to help you!
01 - How do I book a tour with Travlla?
Simply browse our tours, choose your preferred destination and dates, then complete the booking online in a few easy steps. You will receive an instant confirmation email with all the details of your trip.
02 - Can I customise an existing tour package?
Absolutely! Many of our tours can be tailored to your interests, pace and budget. Contact our travel team and we will craft a personalised itinerary just for you.
03 - What is included in the tour price?
Each tour clearly lists what is included, typically accommodation, guided activities, selected meals and local transfers. Flights and personal expenses are usually not included unless stated otherwise.
04 - What payment methods do you accept?
We accept all major credit and debit cards, bank transfers and secure online payments. A deposit is required to confirm your booking, with the balance due before departure.
05 - What is your cancellation and refund policy?
Cancellation terms vary by tour. In most cases, cancellations made well in advance are eligible for a partial or full refund. Please review the specific terms for your booking or contact our support team for assistance.
06 - Do I need travel insurance?
We strongly recommend comprehensive travel insurance for every trip. It protects you against unexpected events such as trip cancellation, medical emergencies and lost luggage.
07 - Are your tours suitable for solo travellers?
Yes! Many of our travellers join solo. Group tours are a great way to meet like-minded people, and our guides ensure everyone feels welcome and included throughout the journey.
08 - What should I pack for my trip?
After booking, we provide a detailed packing list tailored to your destination and the season. As a rule, pack light, bring comfortable footwear and don't forget travel documents and any required medication.
09 - How experienced are your tour guides?
All of our guides are certified local experts with years of experience. They are passionate about sharing the history, culture and hidden gems of each destination.
10 - How can I contact customer support?
Our support team is available 24/7 by phone, email and live chat. Whether you have a question before booking or need help during your trip, we are always here for you.
Reach & Get in Touch With Us!
We'd love to hear from you. Our friendly team is always here to chat.

Budget Travel
10 Breathtaking Destinations You Must Visit in 2024
From hidden island paradises to vibrant cultural capitals, discover the destinations topping every traveller's wishlist this year.
Travel has a way of opening our eyes to new cultures, flavours and perspectives. Whether you are chasing adventure or simply seeking rest, the world is full of places waiting to be explored. Planning ahead is the secret to a stress-free trip. Research your destination, book key experiences in advance and leave room in your itinerary for spontaneous discoveries along the way.
Why This Destination Should Be on Your List
Local guides bring a destination to life in ways no guidebook can. From hidden viewpoints to family-run eateries, their insider knowledge turns a good trip into an unforgettable one.
Plan Ahead for a Smooth Journey
Packing light is an art. Choose versatile clothing, roll your garments to save space and always keep essentials in your carry-on in case your luggage takes a detour. A well-planned budget lets you travel further for longer. Track your spending, travel in shoulder seasons and look for free experiences that reveal the authentic soul of a place.
Travel Like a Local
Connecting with local communities is one of the most rewarding parts of travel. Learn a few phrases in the local language, sample regional dishes and respect the customs of the places you visit.
Travel Responsibly
Sustainable travel matters more than ever. Choose eco-conscious tours, minimise single-use plastics and support businesses that give back to the destinations they call home.
Final Thoughts
The best memories are often made off the beaten path. Wake up early, wander beyond the tourist trail and let curiosity lead you to the moments that make a journey special.

How to Travel the World on a Budget
Practical tips for stretching your travel funds further without missing out on unforgettable experiences.
Travel has a way of opening our eyes to new cultures, flavours and perspectives. Whether you are chasing adventure or simply seeking rest, the world is full of places waiting to be explored. Planning ahead is the secret to a stress-free trip. Research your destination, book key experiences in advance and leave room in your itinerary for spontaneous discoveries along the way.
Why This Destination Should Be on Your List
Local guides bring a destination to life in ways no guidebook can. From hidden viewpoints to family-run eateries, their insider knowledge turns a good trip into an unforgettable one.
Plan Ahead for a Smooth Journey
Packing light is an art. Choose versatile clothing, roll your garments to save space and always keep essentials in your carry-on in case your luggage takes a detour. A well-planned budget lets you travel further for longer. Track your spending, travel in shoulder seasons and look for free experiences that reveal the authentic soul of a place.
Travel Like a Local
Connecting with local communities is one of the most rewarding parts of travel. Learn a few phrases in the local language, sample regional dishes and respect the customs of the places you visit.
Travel Responsibly
Sustainable travel matters more than ever. Choose eco-conscious tours, minimise single-use plastics and support businesses that give back to the destinations they call home.
Final Thoughts
The best memories are often made off the beaten path. Wake up early, wander beyond the tourist trail and let curiosity lead you to the moments that make a journey special.

By System Admin
Jul 27, 2026
City Breaks
Planning the Perfect Family Holiday
How to choose destinations, activities and accommodation that keep every member of the family happy.
Travel has a way of opening our eyes to new cultures, flavours and perspectives. Whether you are chasing adventure or simply seeking rest, the world is full of places waiting to be explored. Planning ahead is the secret to a stress-free trip. Research your destination, book key experiences in advance and leave room in your itinerary for spontaneous discoveries along the way.
Why This Destination Should Be on Your List
Local guides bring a destination to life in ways no guidebook can. From hidden viewpoints to family-run eateries, their insider knowledge turns a good trip into an unforgettable one.
Plan Ahead for a Smooth Journey
Packing light is an art. Choose versatile clothing, roll your garments to save space and always keep essentials in your carry-on in case your luggage takes a detour. A well-planned budget lets you travel further for longer. Track your spending, travel in shoulder seasons and look for free experiences that reveal the authentic soul of a place.
Travel Like a Local
Connecting with local communities is one of the most rewarding parts of travel. Learn a few phrases in the local language, sample regional dishes and respect the customs of the places you visit.
Travel Responsibly
Sustainable travel matters more than ever. Choose eco-conscious tours, minimise single-use plastics and support businesses that give back to the destinations they call home.
Final Thoughts
The best memories are often made off the beaten path. Wake up early, wander beyond the tourist trail and let curiosity lead you to the moments that make a journey special.

Duration:  5 Days / 4 Nights
Group Size:  2–14
Destination: Paris
Activity Type: Sightseeing
Fall under the spell of Paris on this five-day city break. Ascend the Eiffel Tower for sweeping views, wander the masterpiece-filled halls of the Louvre and stroll the grand boulevards from the Arc de Triomphe to Notre-Dame.
Sip coffee in a Left Bank café, cruise the Seine at dusk and lose yourself in the artistic lanes of Montmartre. Elegant, romantic and endlessly inspiring, Paris is a city made to be savoured.

Tour Overview
Duration:  4 Days / 3 Nights
Group Size:  2–14
Destination: Hong Kong
Activity Type: Sightseeing
Feel the electric energy of Hong Kong on this four-day highlights tour. Ride the tram to Victoria Peak for the city's most famous panorama, glide across the harbour on the historic Star Ferry and explore the buzzing markets of Mong Kok.
Feast on round-the-clock dim sum, escape to a tranquil island monastery and watch the skyline erupt in the nightly Symphony of Lights. A thrilling blend of old and new awaits at every turn.

Snorkelers and divers share the water with manta rays, whale sharks, and kaleidoscopic reef fish. Above the surface, glassy calm waters and spectacular sunsets create a serene, romantic retreat unlike anywhere else.

Thailand Overview

Thailand welcomes travellers with golden temples, emerald jungles and some of the friendliest smiles on earth. From the chaos of Bangkok to the serene beaches of the south, the Land of Smiles offers endless variety.

Feast on fragrant street food, explore ancient ruins in Ayutthaya and unwind on palm-fringed islands. Rich culture, warm hospitality and tropical beauty make every visit unforgettable.
